items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you have that record over there, Tim?

ctx.x: Do you have that record over there, Tim? It’s got those saxophones all over it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
It sounds like Charlie Mariano and Sam Noto. I hope I don’t play at this tempo.
